records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Lin,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 3 (2026-07-16), so there is real early engagement, but no key milestone and no invites 6 days in, with 8 days left. Customer engaged only on a bug ticket (tick_012b82cc0f19) and hasn't replied to nudges [email:cd3a3853], [email:99a1b6b5]. Starter, no team pull.

draft.subject: Next step after your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Lin,

Thanks again for flagging the notification badge last week — that one's resolved, and do tell me if it shows up again.

Nice work getting your first project set up. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the next natural step is getting your team's real work and your teammates in alongside it. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? Happy to walk through your next step together.

Best,
Chidi
